skills.atom_scout: No extra effect. Gives 4 power on the front row.

skills.paper_archive: Gives 5 power on the rear row. Its power cannot be raised or lowered this round.

skills.unit_cam_scout: Current rule: when played, choose one enemy unit. Its power -2, minimum 0. Once. Gives 2 power on the rear row. It is still a character.
